draft_key_information_units.information: Geographically, Lithuania contributed EUR 31.4 million (60.2%) of total Q1 2026 sales, followed by other EU countries (EUR 11.3 million) and non-EU countries (EUR 9.3 million).

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units were selected based on the prioritized material themes: headline financial performance (D1, D4, D5), major period-over-period changes in profitability (D2, D3, D4, D5), liquidity and cash flow (D6, D7), and important segment developments (D8, D9). All units are directly supportable by the SOURCE without inventing causal relationships or combining separate events. Routine boilerplate (governance, accounting policies, auditor details) was excluded. The selection aligns with the requirement for concise summary-level content, covering approximately 6–10 key units (9 units here), with HIGH importance assigned to central performance drivers and liquidity, and MEDIUM to materially relevant but less central segment data.
